trial_court: Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, D.K. Mangaluru - MC No. 208/2021
case_name: Mrs. Anita Nayak vs Mr. Uday Nayak
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2018. The respondent filed a petition for dissolution of marriage. The petitioner appeared and filed a counter denying the allegations. The trial court allowed interim maintenance to the tune of Rs.30,000/- per month.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside an order.
legal_principles.held: Though the petitioner has produced the documents before the Family Court, it is not disputed that the marriage of the petitioner and respondent was solemnized as per the customs prevailing in their community.

legal_principles.principle: The law is clear that a party cannot avoid the payment of interim maintenance by alleging a second marriage.
legal_principles.held: He submits that the respondent has made an allegation against the petitioner to avoid the payment of interim maintenance.

outcome.final_order: The writ petition challenging the order dated 14.09.2023 passed by the Principal Judge, Family Court, D.K. Mangaluru was dismissed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
advising on property division in a divorce case
representing a client in a family court
